india.one_line: Indian startups secure health funding and partnerships, while courts address AI errors and library compliance.

themes.title: Indian health startups secure funding and adoption
themes.text: Pune-based Froncort.AI raised $2.3 million from Google.org for disease surveillance, and the National Health Authority selected EkaCare to deploy an AI Voice Scribe in public facilities.

stories.headline: Froncort.AI raises $2.3M from Google.org to expand AI disease surveillance
NHA selects EkaCare for AI Voice Scribe in public health facilities

themes.title: Courts address AI hallucinations and procurement issues
themes.text: The Bombay High Court quashed a customs order citing non-existent judgments, while the Madras High Court ordered an FIR over AI-generated books in public libraries.

stories.headline: Bombay High Court quashes customs order citing AI-hallucinated judgments
Madras High Court rules AI-generated books violate library rules, orders FIR

themes.title: Cognizant launches Claude capability group
themes.text: Cognizant formed a Claude Frontier Capability Group with 25,000 professionals and certified 44,000 associates on Anthropic's assistant.

stories.headline: Cognizant forms Claude Frontier Capability Group with 25,000 staff
